114.note: The Escape: William Pestle (253) brews the Invisibility Liquor in a short scene after Collecting Kelp (112) is handed in, and offers The Escape only then; the route fills the wait at Marshal Dughan a few yards away. Reported by a player and confirmed by the fix in the shipped guide; sec is an estimate (a few seconds).

151.note: Poor Old Blanchy: the Sacks of Oats are gathered in the Jansen Stead's own fields (56.8,19.1: 19 known sacks within 150 yd, 32 within 250), not searched for over all 119 sacks in Westfall; the reporter found the far ones empty. Confirmed by the fix in the shipped guide.

470.note: Digging Through the Ooze: the quest text says one of the oozes at Ironbeard's Tomb has Sida's Bag, so the search is at the tomb (44.6,25.6, the shipped guide's arrow spot: 26 spawns within 130 yd), not every ooze in the Wetlands. Confirmed by the fix in the shipped guide.

2459.note: Ferocitas the Dream Eater: Tallonkai's Jewel (8050) is not a drop; it comes out of the Gnarlpine Necklace (8049) that Ferocitas (7234) drops, opened in the bags. Step 2 (loot the necklace) drives, so the guide collects the necklace before the jewel. Confirmed by the fix in the shipped guide; the container parameter from the game data agrees.
